svg.aria-label: Taxes & Insurance Group. Bilingual site for a Kissimmee tax and insurance firm, with an admin CMS and an AI chat assistant. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Claude API. Security: JWT sessions in httpOnly cookies, scrypt password hashing, rate-limited public endpoints.
